title: Add TutoredWriteRouter coverage for the 4 always-pass-through methods in s1_tutored_write_router_test.dart

evidence.quote: // S1 — TutoredWriteRouter unit tests ... AC1..AC4 (no mention of pushSettings/pushLearningOrder/pushUiPreferencesSnapshot/deleteLearnerProfile)
//   deleteLearnerProfile (talmid's profile deletion is not a tutor right).

why: The router's own comment says deleteLearnerProfile is deliberately excluded from tutor routing because talmid profile deletion is not a tutor right — a documented access-control decision. This 1003-line test file (tagged 'keystone') exhaustively covers the other 10 intercepted entity kinds across tutored/non-tutored/CF-failure branches, but grep confirms zero calls to pushSettings, pushLearningOrder, pushUiPreferencesSnapshot, or deleteLearnerProfile anywhere in the file (or anywhere else in test/features/tutoring). If a future edit accidentally applied the `if (sel == null) return _delegate.X(...)` interception pattern to deleteLearnerProfile with the condition backwards, a tutor could trigger deletion of the talmid's profile via a CF call and nothing in this suite would fail.
recommendation: Add an 'always pass-through' group mirroring the existing tutored/non-tutored pattern: call each of the 4 methods via _tutored(record, delegate) and assert record.wasCalled is false and the matching delegate counter incremented.
acceptance_criteria: s1_tutored_write_router_test.dart asserts deleteLearnerProfile in tutored mode never invokes the CF invoker and always reaches the delegate
Same coverage added for pushSettings, pushLearningOrder, pushUiPreferencesSnapshot

corrections: Comment quote cited at line 30 actually starts at line 31 (line 30 is 'pushSettings, pushLearningOrder, pushUiPreferencesSnapshot,'); adjacent line, content unaffected.
